newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit details unit spinoff plan.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit details unit spinoff plan.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co Ltd said its spinoff unit, Leading Spirit Conrowa Electric Co Ltd (LSC), would issue 393.12 million new shares in a flotation, of which 70 percent would offered for public subscription.

Leading Spirit said about 275.184 million new LSC shares would be earmarked for public subscription, 39.312 million shares for employees, and 78.624 million shares for a preferential offer to Leading Spirit's existing shareholders.

Of the public offering portion, half will be allocated to pool A for applicants seeking shares worth HK$5 million or less, and half will be allocated to pool B for those seeking shares worth more than HK$5 million and up to 50 percent of the issue.
Where either pool is undersubscribed, unsubscribed shares should be transferred to satisfy demand in the other pool.
Last month, Leading Spirit proposed to spinoff its wholly-owned LSC by issuing HK$393 million worth of new shares.

It said the new issue would include a preferential offer to existing Leading Spirit shareholders in the proportion of one LSC share for every 50 Leading Spirit shares held, and one free LSC warrant for every 30 Leading Spirit shares held.

LSC is engaged in the design, manufacture, assembly and sale of electrical home appliances such as television sets, washing machines and air-conditioners. It also trades parts and components for the manufacture of home appliances.
